whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Jay Matadi Bhojnalaya,

I noticed your bhojnalaya has strong 4.3★ reviews in Rajbansi Nagar, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for daily meal subscriptions and food orders.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp food ordering, daily thali menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://jay-matadi-bhojnalaya-demo.arclane.studio

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Jay Matadi Bhojnalaya team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Jay Matadi Bhojnalaya in Rajbansi Nagar) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp food ordering, daily thali menu, and location directions for Strand Road customers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
